tools.name: get_products
tools.description: Return product-catalog records. Fields mirror the CDGC-governed dim_product.csv columns, including unit_cost (Business Term marked Confidential). The MCP Tool Response Field Entitlement Filter masks fields the caller's clearance/purpose don't entitle them to.

tools.name: get_customers
tools.description: Return customer records. Fields mirror the CDGC-governed dim_customer.csv columns, including credit_limit (Business Term marked Confidential). The MCP Tool Response Field Entitlement Filter masks fields the caller's clearance/purpose don't entitle them to.
